'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''  
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]] 
**The [[Tatmadaw]] carries out an air strike in the [[Sagaing Region]], [[Myanmar]] killing at least ten civilians and injuring more than a dozen others, according to local officials and eyewitnesses. Thirteen homes are also destroyed according to officials. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/06/29/asia/myanmar-junta-airstrike-sagaing-pale-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Canadian wildfires]]
**[[Smoke from the 2023 Canadian wildfires]]
***Smoke from the ongoing Canadian [[wildfire]]s is reported to have entered the [[U.S. state|U.S. states]] of [[Connecticut]], [[Massachusetts]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[Vermont]], [[South Carolina]], [[Arkansas]] and even small parts of [[Florida]] and [[Mississippi]]. [https://www.ctinsider.com/weather/article/ct-air-quality-canadian-wildfire-smoke-18176620.php (CT Insider)] [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/wildfire-smoke-map-us-cities-forecast-impacted-wildfires/story?id=100439224 (ABC News)]
***Smoke from the Canadian wildfires is confirmed by satellite data to have reached the [[United Kingdom]], according to the [[Met Office]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-66058108 (BBC News)]
*Seven people are killed and seven others are missing after [[flood]]s, followed by a [[tornado]], in [[KwaZulu-Natal]], [[South Africa]], strike [[Durban]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/29/four-dead-one-missing-after-heavy-rain-tornado-in-south-africa (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign involvement in the Syrian civil war]]
**The [[United Nations General Assembly]] approves the creation of an independent body to investigate [[Syrian civil war]]-related [[missing person]]s. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20230629-un-general-assembly-establishes-body-to-probe-fate-of-syria-s-missing (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2023 Chinese balloon incident]]
**The [[United States Department of Defense]] says it has assessed that the Chinese balloon spotted over the United States and alleged to be a spy balloon did not collect information over the United States. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jun/29/chinese-spy-balloon-shot-information-biden (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Burkina Faso]] [[Censorship|bans]] French news channel [[La Chaîne Info]] for three months for allegedly disseminating [[fake news]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/01/world/burkina-faso-bans-french-news-channel-lci/1898505 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Killing of Nahel Merzouk]]
**Rioters set fires across several neighborhoods in [[Cayenne]], [[French Guiana]], and a government employee is killed by a stray bullet. [[List of colonial and departmental heads of French Guiana|Prefect]] [[Thierry Queffelec]] announces the suspension of the city's public transportation system and a temporary ban on the sale of gasoline at night. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/riots-erupt-french-caribbean-territories-reaction-unrest-france-100554046 (ABC News)]
**[[Riot]]ing continues for a third night across [[France]] with at least 100 people being arrested as 40,000 [[Law enforcement in France|police officers]] are deployed to tackle the unrest. A [[town hall]] is [[arson|set on fire]] in [[Clichy-sous-Bois]], while supermarkets and other shops are [[looting|looted]] by gangs in [[Nantes]] and [[Montreuil, Seine-Saint-Denis]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-europe-66049895 (BBC News)]
*[[Islamic scarf controversy in France]]
**[[France]]'s top administrative court upholds a ban on female footballers wearing [[Islamic headscarves]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230629-top-french-court-upholds-hijab-ban-in-women-s-football (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Rwanda asylum plan]]
**The [[Court of Appeal (England and Wales)|Court of Appeal]] rejects the [[British government]]'s plan to fly [[asylum seeker]]s to [[Rwanda]], deeming the plan to be unlawful. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/06/29/world/europe/uk-rwanda-migrants-unlawful.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2023/jun/29/plan-to-send-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda-is-unlawful-uk-appeal-court-rules (''The Guardian'')]
*''[[Students for Fair Admissions v. Harvard]]''
**In a 6–3 decision, the [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]] rules that race can no longer be considered a factor in university admissions, effectively ending [[Affirmative action in the United States|affirmative action]] in higher learning. However, the court also rules that race considerations are still permitted for military academy admissions. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/supreme-court-affirmative-action-race-college-admissions-harvard-north-carolina/ (CBS News)]
*[[Protests against Quran desecration in Sweden]]
**Dozens of people storm the compound of the [[Embassy of Sweden, Baghdad|Swedish embassy]] in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], after an Iraqi living in [[Sweden]] [[Quran desecration|sets fire]] to a copy of the [[Quran]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66052670 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Turkmenistan]] inaugurates its first [[smart city]], [[Arkadag]], named after former [[President of Turkmenistan|president]] [[Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedow|Gurbanguly "Arkadag" Berdimuhamedow]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/06/29/world/turkmenistan-unveils-5-b-city-in-honor-of-national-leader/1898392 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Billionaire space race]]
**American [[spaceflight]] company [[Virgin Galactic]] successfully launches [[Galactic 01]], its first [[private spaceflight]], from [[Spaceport America]] in [[New Mexico]], [[United States]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3226000/virgin-galactic-takes-its-first-paying-customers-space (AFP via ''SCMP'')]
*The [[North American Nanohertz Observatory for Gravitational Waves|NANOGrav]] consortium announces detection of a cosmic [[gravitational wave background]] in the signals from [[pulsar]]s. [https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/scientists-thrill-at-first-hints-of-cosmic-hum-from-giant-gravitational-waves/ (Scientific American)]
